definition: clock_slew_ps is the nominal Liberty10–90% rise (90–10% fall) slew at the ideal driven input CK port. The generator divides by0.8 to obtain the full linear0–100% PWL edge width.
generator_pwl_function:
def pwl(initial,events,stop):
    points=[(0.,initial*.7)];previous=initial
    for center,bit,slew_ps in events:
        width=slew_ps*1e-12/.8
        points.extend([(center-width/2,previous*.7),(center+width/2,bit*.7)]);previous=bit
    points.append((stop,previous*.7))
    assert all(points[i][0]>=points[i-1][0] for i in range(1,len(points)))
    return 'pwl('+ ' '.join(f'{t:.17g} {v:.17g}' for t,v in points)+')'
coverage_limitation: 64 functional tests sample clock slews2.5/20/160ps and selected loads/stimuli. They are not full native7x7 timing/power/constraint/MPW characterization; that remains a separate pending native run.
